title: Transport-neutral degradation and live capacity contracts
summary: Planner v0.1-dev5 controls named capacity domains, contexts and aggregate tickets. Per-context caps, max parallel count and aggregate ceiling are three distinct constraints; XTP must not claim global accounting absent fabric coordination.
invariants: NORMAL, DEGRADED, CONSTRAINED and EMERGENCY are operating-state inputs
Allowed decisions include ALLOW THROTTLE SAMPLE AGGREGATE DEFER SUSPEND DROP REFUSE_FORWARD
SAMPLE/AGGREGATE require verified upstream transformation, never forward original unchanged
fallback ALLOW/FORBID/REQUIRE is independent of disposition and path protection
Live contraction/recovery must not destroy already verified Storage ranges
A capacity percentage applies to named resource current capacity, not an IP interface or service label
procedure: Admit mu5 and mu7 normal.storage tickets against 100-unit ingress, each <=30 and total <=60
Reject/queue third mu9 ticket at max_parallel_contexts=2
Reduce current resource to 50, reconcile tickets to <=15 each and <=30 aggregate
Verify high-class competition preempts/deprioritises normal.storage safely
Restore capacity with bounded grant ramp to avoid a thundering herd

qualification_boundaries.local_numeric: planner and synthetic pressure tests; no full sustained multi-source ED209 transfer claimed
